description: PICKET globe-layer payload: geolocated source IPs from the honeypot sensor's trailing-7-day activity.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp this payload was generated/published.

schema_version.description: Published payload schema version; bump on any breaking shape change.

attribution.description: Attribution and provenance notice for this payload's data and geolocation source.

ips.description: Geolocated source IPs observed by the sensor, most active first.

ip.description: Public source IP literal (IPv4 or IPv6).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for this IP, if known.

lat.description: Latitude of this IP's resolved geolocation.

lng.description: Longitude of this IP's resolved geolocation.

source.description: Payload origin tag for this row, always "picket".

hits_7d.description: Knocks from this IP in the last 7 days.

first_seen.description: Timestamp this IP was first observed. Present only when the sensor records it — knock-knock v3 keeps no per-IP first-seen, so P1 exports omit it.

last_seen.description: Timestamp this IP was last observed.

geo_precision.description: Granularity of the resolved geolocation for this IP.
